desc: Generic-class personalities (voice variants) offered at character creation: 3 rows per class voice group (26 human + 21 monster classes = 141 rows x 348). Looked up by (voice_group, variant). A new generic class needs 3 rows with its voice_group (char.dat voice_id/10) and matching Sound_Voice data to have selectable voices.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: personality entry id 0..131 (not unique: the DLC classes 124-126 reuse 129-131)

fields.name: voice_group
fields.desc: generic class voice group = char.dat voice_id / 10 (101 Warrior .. 126 Sorcerer, 201 Prinny .. 221 Horseman); Sound_Voice ids of this group are voice_group*100000+n

fields.name: variant
fields.desc: personality index 0..2 within the class (the 3 selectable voices/personalities at character creation)

fields.name: name_JP
fields.desc: personality name shown when creating a character ("Cool", "Quietly Burning", ...)
